title: Google is working on HDR emoji for Chat
description: An APK teardown of the latest version of Gmail revealed that Google is looking to bring HDR emoji to its Chat app. That’s the Google Hangouts successor, which is part of the Google Workspace suite, for those outside the loop on Google software. A specific code string in the newest Gmail build hints at “display-supported emoji in high dynamic range (HDR) with enhanced brightness and contrast”. This feature is simply titled HDR emoji and will likely feature brighter emoji characters with higher contrast for easier legibility. This could be exclusive to custom emoji symbols but the code...

title: SpaceX buys spectrum for Starlink to become a full-fledged US mobile carrier
description: Elon Musk’s SpaceX has just acquired up to 14MHz of paired spectrum in the 800MHz band nationwide in the US, from Grain Management. Musk says this is "the last critical piece of the spectrum puzzle needed for SpaceX to provide complete phone coverage in America". So the aim here is clear. Use Starlink satellites to provide mobile phone coverage outdoors, and this 800MHz spectrum to provide indoor coverage. Most existing smartphones already support this band. title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max running iOS 27.2 beta receives AT&T carrier update
description: Apple has released an emergency carrier bundle update for iPhone 18 Pro Max units on AT&T running iOS 27.2 beta. The update has version 72.0.3 and comes a week after Apple released carrier update 72.1 for iOS 27.0 users, while devices running iOS 27.2 beta remained on 72.0.2. title: The RedMagic 12 Pro+ is shaping up to be an RGB lover’s dream
description: RedMagic’s upcoming flagship, the 12 Pro+, is set to launch in China next week. After revealing the phone’s design and color options recently, the brand has now shared details about the device’s cooling system. The RedMagic 12 Pro+ will be the world’s first smartphone to feature an RGB liquid cooling system, the company revealed in a post on Weibo. While nubia has yet to explain how the RGB lighting will work, it has revealed some details about the liquid cooling system. title: Computer market shipments fell 20% between July and September
description: According to the latest data from IDC, global computer shipments fell 20.1% in the third quarter of the year (July-September) compared to the same period last year, reaching 62.7 million units. This is the second consecutive quarter of decline, following a much smaller drop of 3.8% in Q2. Shipments in Q3 also fell by 9.1% compared to the previous quarter, so it's anything but a great situation for the industry. There are some things to keep in mind, though. title: Global Xiaomi 18 Pro Max has its chipset and RAM amount confirmed by a benchmark
description: Xiaomi has already confirmed that the 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max will be launched internationally, unlike their predecessors from last year. And so with the 18 Ultra rumored to have been canceled, the 18 Pro Max will essentially be the company's flagship smartphone going into 2027. Now, its global version has been spotted in the online results database of Geekbench AI. It has the model number 2611FPNFAG. description: Oppo officially confirmed the ColorOS 17 global launch for October 13 next week, and OnePlus just opened up registrations for OnePlus users to get an early taste of the software. Notably, this isn't the final build of the software that OnePlus is seeding, of course, it's the ColorOS 17 Open Beta. For now, only Indian users can apply and get early access, and the application window is running from October 9 through October 12, just a day before the official release. title: OnePlus 16 display specs confirmed
description: The OnePlus 16 is going official next week and ahead of the big unveiling, the brand revealed more key info for the upcoming flagship. The phone will be equipped with a BOE X4 LTPO OLED display. The panel is set to bring 1.5K resolution and up to 185Hz refresh rate, though the max 185Hz will only be available in gaming mode. The phone will run at up to 165Hz in everyday tasks, but you’ll be able to “unlock” the extra 20Hz in supported gaming titles like Arena Breakout, Nizhan: Future, Naruto Mobile, and Peace Elite. title: Report: Apple cuts iPhone 18 Pro series component orders amid weak demand
description: According to a new report, Apple has asked some of its suppliers to reduce production of components for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. The report, citing people familiar with the matter, claims that Apple cut component orders by up to 15% for October. The reduction is reportedly driven by weaker market demand amid soaring memory prices. Meanwhile, the report also notes that demand for the new iPhones has been weaker than for last year’s models. description: Rumors about a wide-screen flagship smartphone from Oppo have been circulating for some time. A new leak has now revealed details on the device’s display aspect ratio and overall width. Tipster Digital Chat Station claims that Oppo’s wide-screen smartphone, rumored to be called the Reno X, will feature a 16:9 display. description: Yesterday, a report claimed that Apple is planning two separate product launches this month. While the company has confirmed the first event, scheduled for October 13, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman has now revealed when the second launch could take place. description: The iQOO Neo11 came out in October of last year, so it's pretty much time for its successor to show up any day now. According to a new rumor from Digital Chat Station on Weibo, the iQOO Neo12 may be packing a very unique screen. description: Xiaomi launched the Redmi Turbo 5 Max earlier this year with a 9,000mAh battery and a 6.83-inch display. Now, a new rumor suggests that its successor, the Redmi Turbo 6 Max, could feature an even larger battery and display. title: Another vivo V80 is coming, certification reveals
description: A few days ago, vivo launched the V80, which follows in the footsteps of the V80 Lite that got official last month. But the V80 series isn't done yet - there's (at least) another member of the family on the way. Indonesia's SDPPI has certified a vivo phone with the model number V2624 under the name vivo V80 FE. Unfortunately, the certification doesn't reveal any specs or any details about the phone whatsoever, aside from its name and model number. Xiaomi smartphone owners will be able to share photos, files, contacts, and web pages with an iPhone. Even better, HyperOS 4 will let users view cloud photo albums on either smartphone. There are also real-time notifications and instant message replies across the two ecosystems thanks to two-way sync. title: Amazon Kids Tablets are now official in two sizes
description: Today Amazon has unveiled two tablets aimed at kids, and they're unsurprisingly called the Amazon Kids Tablets. They are available in 8.7" and 11" sizes, with two distinct models, one made for ages 3+, the other for ages 6+. The 8.7-inch tablet has 64GB of storage and its battery lasts for up to 14 hours of video playback, while the 11" model has "a beautiful 2.5K display" and 8GB of RAM. title: The OLED MacBook Pro may not be much thinner than the current model
description: Apple's long-rumored OLED MacBook Pro, which will be its first laptop with a touchscreen, may not end up being much thinner than the current model, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman. He has thus contradicted his own previous predictions, now saying that he doesn't think "it'll be significantly thinner in the end". For reference, the current MacBook Pro 14" is 15.5mm thick and weighs between 1.55kg and 1.62kg, while the 16-inch model is 16.8mm thick and weighs between 2.14kg and 2.15kg. So there's definitely a lot of room to make the new ones lighter, and perhaps slightly thinner...

title: Amazon's new Alexa Tablets use the Google Play Store and are more capable than Fire tablets
description: Amazon first got into the tablet game with the Kindle Fire. It later dropped the “Kindle” branding to emphasize that its tablets do more than its e-readers. And now the company is changing tack again with the introduction of the Amazon Alexa tablets. As you can tell from the name, AI is a big part of this. However, the change in naming also emphasizes that these are fully-featured Android tablets – Fire tablets were known for being cheap but good enough (and did we mention cheap?). title: Here's how thin the iPhone Air 2 will be despite having better battery life than its predecessor
description: According to a new rumor, the iPhone Air 2, expected to launch next spring alongside the iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e, will be even thinner than its predecessor. How thin? 5.2mm. That's 0.4mm less than the original iPhone Air from 2025. Obviously it's a tiny difference, but you can't really expect much since the iPhone Air was already very thin.
